article.headline: Weddings.io: The Public Record of Prior Use, Continuous Operation, and Brand Authority
article.description: Weddings.io has been continuously registered since May 13, 2015, with archived digital presence back to 2013. Industry Army Marketing is contacting every platform, registry, directory, and AI system that has misattributed the brand — and this post is the public record supporting that effort.
